blockingReasons: Alaska Future Fund's current ownership status and percentage are not publicly resolved after its November 2021 investment.
Whether Investment Company of Alaska or C Change retained equity after Tiger's controlling acquisition remains unresolved.
rationale: NorthLink remains an active U.S. airport-infrastructure development controlled by Tiger Infrastructure Partners Fund III. The current record nevertheless requires material correction: the State of Alaska is lessor rather than an equity owner; Alaska Future Fund was a disclosed co-investor; and the terminal is delayed, phased construction rather than an operating facility. Latest AIAS evidence supports six hardstands planned by 2027 and no terminal opening. No Tiger exit or pending sponsor transaction was found. Application remains blocked because the current Alaska Future Fund and C Change minority positions are not publicly resolved.
recommendedChanges: Retain one NorthLink Aviation LLC record at northlink-aviation|united-states and add IC Alaska Airport LLC as the predecessor name rather than a duplicate.
Keep Tiger Infrastructure Partners Fund III as the active controlling sponsor with the November 3, 2021 entry date and an undisclosed percentage.
Remove the sole-owner representation and preserve Alaska Future Fund as a disclosed November 2021 co-investor whose current status requires review before application.
Do not infer State of Alaska equity from ADA-32351; record the State and Ted Stevens Anchorage International Airport as landlord/lessor only.
Correct the project status to active delayed phased construction, not operating, and date-qualify the 15-stand and 90,000-square-foot design plus six-hardstand 2027 plan.
Keep the lease, campus, apron, warehouse, hardstands and later phases beneath the canonical NorthLink company.
unresolvedQuestions: Exact ownership percentages and the current minority cap table are not publicly disclosed.
Whether C Change or Investment Company of Alaska retained equity after the 2021 control acquisition is unresolved.
The acquisition SPV, construction financing and firm commercial-service date are not publicly disclosed.
